definitions.gloss: combination skin; a mixed skin type (oily in some areas, dry in others)
definitions.explanation: A skin type in which different parts of the face have different characteristics — most commonly oily in the T-zone (forehead, nose, chin) and dry or normal on the cheeks. Standard category in Japanese skincare, alongside {脂性肌|しせいはだ}, {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}, and {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{混合肌|こんごうはだ}だ。
{混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スキンケア→スキンケア：23083_sukinkea⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Skincare for combination skin is tricky.

examples.japanese: {混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、T⟦ゾーン→ゾーン：11033_zoon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{皮脂|ひし}→皮脂：27786_hishi⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保湿力|ほしつりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: For combination skin, it's a good idea to use separate products — a sebum-control toner for the T-zone and a highly moisturizing cream for the cheeks.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{混合|こんごう}→混合：04154_kongou⟧ ('mixture; combination') and ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ ('skin'). Widely used in cosmetics marketing and skincare columns to describe faces that have both oily and dry areas at the same time.

USAGE:
- Japanese skincare routines often encourage 'zone-based' care for {混合肌|こんごうはだ}, applying different products to different parts of the face.
- Frequently appears in labels and recommendations: {混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ ('for combination skin'), {混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧ ('recommended for combination skin').
- Considered one of the most common skin types, especially in humid climates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧: toner for combination skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スキンケア→スキンケア：23083_sukinkea⟧: skincare for combination skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: products aimed at combination skin
- {混合肌|こんごうはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧: concerns of those with combination skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脂性肌|しせいはだ}→脂性肌：23960_shiseihada⟧: oily skin — oily across the whole face.
- ⟦{乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}→乾燥肌：16609_kansouhada⟧: dry skin — dry across the whole face.
- {普通肌|ふつうはだ}: normal skin — balanced, without obvious oily or dry areas.
- ⟦{敏感肌|びんかんはだ}→敏感肌：19065_binkanhada⟧: sensitive skin — skin that reacts easily to products, environment, or stress.
- T⟦ゾーン→ゾーン：11033_zoon⟧: T-zone — the forehead–nose–chin area, often the oily part of a {混合肌|こんごうはだ} face.
